result.excerpts:
[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Course overview and prerequisites (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.
Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Model ki ungliyan judi / extra (course-material) [Lesson 03; lesson_3]
Model ki ungliyan judi / extra "natural hands with five fingers" + dobara generate. Haath AI ke liye mushkil hain. (L03)
Reviewed English translation: Add “natural hands with five fingers” and regenerate. Hands are difficult for AI; inspect the fingers before using the image.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Model shots (course-material) [Lesson 03; lesson_3]
• Character sheet + product sheet dono reference mein. • Model ke kapde/look prompt mein sheet se match karke likho. • "natural hands with five fingers" likho. 2–3 versions banao.
Reviewed English translation: Attach both the character sheet and product sheet. Match the model’s clothes and look to the character sheet, keep the same face, and include “natural hands with five fingers”. Generate 2–3 versions and check the result.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
• Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.
Reviewed English translation: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the face, character sheet and product sheet. Recorded settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. The camera itself is the phone: no phone should appear in the frame. Use a normal home room and short dialogue written in Hindi Devanagari, based on the L05 hook. Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Har photo mein product thoda alag (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
Har photo mein product thoda alag Sheet ke bina bana rahe ho. Pehle product sheet banao, phir har dikh raha photo usi se. (L02, L08)
Reviewed English translation: First make a product sheet, then use the same sheet as the reference for every new product image.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Ad plan (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
• Ek hi chat mein: details + price + kahan bechte ho → 3 buyers, problems, angles. • Angle chuno → 5 hooks + 15-sec script + caption, "use only the features I gave you". • Flow ke 3 image prompts likhwao → Flow mein product sheet ke saath chalao. • Output padh ke jhoothe/unproven claims hatao.
Reviewed English translation: Provide real product details, price and where you sell. First ask for three buyer types, their problems and an ad angle for each. Choose one angle, then request 5 hooks, a 15-second script and an Instagram caption. Use only supplied features; add no unsupported claims. Next request 3 Google Flow image prompts and run them with the product sheet. Review and remove false or unproven claims.
